# Muhammed Rifad KP (Rifad)

> Muhammed Rifad KP is a full-stack web developer based in Calicut, Kerala, India. He builds websites, online stores and web apps for businesses in the United Arab Emirates and India, using Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js and MongoDB. This is his portfolio: https://www.rifad.site

## Key facts

- Name: Muhammed Rifad KP (also known as Rifad)
- Role: Freelance full-stack web developer and IT teacher
- Location: Calicut (Kozhikode), Kerala, India. Works remotely with clients in the UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi) and across India
- Education: Bachelor of Computer Applications, Yenepoya University, Mangaluru (2021 to 2024)

- Projects shown: 16

## Services

- Business websites: Fast, search-ready sites for clinics, agencies, real estate and service companies, with enquiries going to WhatsApp or email.
- Online stores: Catalogues, filters, carts and checkout, from a small shop to a store with a custom product finder.
- Web apps: Logins, roles, dashboards and APIs on React, Node.js and MongoDB, like the attendance system running at an institute today.
- 3D on the web: Interactive models and scroll scenes in Three.js, like the workstation and the flight on this page.

## How a project goes

1. You tell me what you need. Send a message on WhatsApp or by email. We have a short call, and I come back with a plan and a price before any work starts.
2. I design it around your customers. Pages, wording and layout are planned for the people who will use the site, and for a phone screen first.
3. I build it where you can see it. You get a preview link while I build, so you watch the site take shape and can ask for changes while they are still easy.
4. It goes live, and I stay. I connect your domain, set the site up for Google and hand it over. Updates, fixes and new pages are covered after launch.

- [Pixel Conversions](https://www.rifad.site/projects/pixel-conversions): Web and growth agency. An agency site that sells custom Next.js builds, Shopify stores and paid growth, and turns visitors into booked calls. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Shopify. Live at https://www.pixelconversions.com/

Live at https://zhmrealestatellc.ae

Live at https://www.onepackonline.com/

## Questions and answers

### What do you build?
Business websites, online stores and web apps, front end to database. If you need 3D or motion on the page, that too.

### How long does a project take?
Most websites take two to four weeks. Larger apps take one to three months, depending on what they have to do.

### Do you look after the site after launch?
Yes. I offer ongoing maintenance and support, so updates, fixes and new pages are covered.

### What does a website cost?
Every project is priced on what it has to do. Tell me the pages and features you need, and I send a plan with a price before any work starts.

### Which technologies do you use?
Next.js and React on the front end, Node.js, Express and MongoDB on the back end, Tailwind CSS for styling and Vercel for hosting. For stores I also work with Shopify.

### Where are you based, and who do you work with?
I work from Calicut (Kozhikode) in Kerala, India, with businesses in the UAE and across India. Everything happens online, over WhatsApp, email and calls.

### How do we start?
Send a message on WhatsApp or by email with what you have in mind. We set up a short call and I come back with a plan and a price.
